message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each 1‑9, one 0) and two of each action card:
• Skip
• Reverse
• Draw Two
• Wild
• Wild Draw Four | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile. Turn the top card face‑up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score **500 points** (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Turn Order** | Players sit around the table. The first turn goes to the player left of the dealer. Turn order moves clockwise unless a Reverse card changes direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard. If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes direction of play.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. **(Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you can be challenged.)** | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your **second‑to‑last** card, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **Continuing Play** | After scoring, shuffle the discard pile (except the top card) to form a new draw pile and start a new round. The winner of the previous round deals the next round. | | **Winning the Game** | The first player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on the color** – if you’re low on cards, try to keep a variety of colors so you can always play something. 2. **Use Wilds strategically** – save them for when you’re stuck or to force opponents into a tough spot. 3. **Watch for “UNO”** – both to call it yourself and to catch others who forget. 4. **Challenge a Wild Draw Four** – if you suspect the player had a playable card, you can challenge. If they were right, you draw four; if they were wrong, you draw six. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
